name: BayTech Generic (MIB)
description: Auto-compiled with libsmi from 2 MIB module(s). 176 readable OIDs under 1.3.6.1.4.1.4779.

oids.name: sBTAIdentFirmwareRev
oids.description: An 8 byte ID string identifying the DS72 firmware revision. This value is set at the factory.

oids.name: sBTAIdentSerialNumber
oids.description: A number identifying the serial number of the DS72. This value is set at the factory.

oids.name: sBTAIdentUnitName
oids.description: A 64-character string identifying the name (UnitID) of the DS72. This value is set at the factory to a default of DS72.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigBootpEnable
oids.description: Enables/disables bootp. Bootp will not take effect until the unit is reseted.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigDHCPEnable
oids.description: Enables/disables DHCP. DHCP will not take effect until the unit is reseted.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigSSHEnable
oids.description: Enables/disables SSH logins. Disable/enable SSH will take effect after the unit is reseted.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigTelnetEnable
oids.description: Enables/disables telnet.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigActivityTimeout
oids.description: A value from 0 to 120. 0 disables activity timeouts. Value represents minutes of non-activity before telnet / SSH sessions are automatically logged out. Default is 0.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigDirectConnEnable
oids.description: Enables/disables direct port connection upon login.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigSNMPReadOnlyCommunity
oids.description: The community name to use for read only access. Maximum len 16 bytes.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigSNMPReadWriteCommunity
oids.description: The community name to use for read-write access. Maximum len 16 bytes.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigSNMPNumTrapReceivers
oids.description: The maximum number of managers to send traps to. Currently 4.

oids.name: trapIndex
oids.description: The index to a trap receiver entry.

oids.name: receiverAddress
oids.description: The IP address of the manager to send traps to.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigRadiusEnable
oids.description: Enables / disables RADIUS telnet logins.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigRadiusPrimaryServer
oids.description: Ip address of the primary RADIUS server.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigRadiusSecondaryServer
oids.description: Ip address of the back-up RADIUS server.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigRadiusLocalLogin
oids.description: Enables / disables the use of local (usernames stored in the DS72) logins in the case that both the primary and secondary RADIUS server are not available.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigWebEnable
oids.description: Enables WEB.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigWebSecureEnable
oids.description: Enables WEB Security.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigWebLoginEnable
oids.description: Enables WEB Login.

oids.name: sBTANetworkConfigWebActivityTimeout
oids.description: A value from 0 to 120. 0 disables WEB activity timeouts. Value represents minutes of non-activity before WEB sessions are automatically logged out. Default is 0.
